login.title: Sign in

error.unavailable: The service is unavailable. Please try again in a few minutes.

login.intro: Sign in with the details your firm gave you. The firm and email are remembered on this computer; the password never is.
login.help: Don't have your sign-in details, or forgot them? Ask your firm's administrator.

workspace.catalogError: The catalogs could not be loaded. Reload the page.

jurisdiction.scopeNote: Federal law always applies; widening the scope is your decision.

workspace.includeHistorical: Include earlier versions (no longer in force)

stage.generating: Drafting from the retrieved sources and verifying the citations…

error.rate_limited: Too many requests in a row. Wait a few seconds and try again.
error.llm_unavailable: The model service is unavailable right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
error.model_not_allowed: The firm does not allow external models. An administrator can enable them in Settings; meanwhile, start a conversation with a local model.
error.model_unavailable: That model is not configured on this server. Start a conversation with another model.
error.model_declined: The external model provider declined the request. No answer was generated.
error.cites_matter_files: This conversation cites documents of another matter. So that people outside that matter never see them, it can only stay in its original matter or outside every matter.
error.session: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
error.generic: The request could not be completed. Please try again.

answer.title: Answer
answer.gap: Not enough sources for this section.
answer.verified: {count, plural, =1 {# citation checked} other {# citations checked}} against the text of the law
answer.reasoningCount: {count, plural, =1 {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}} of own analysis, without normative support

refusal.title: Insufficient sources
refusal.intro: The system cannot answer this question rigorously with the available sources. This is not an error.

retrieval.no_hits: No source from this jurisdiction related to the question was retrieved.
retrieval.below_threshold: The retrieved sources are not relevant enough to the question.

validation.model_declined: The model could not support an answer with the retrieved sources.
validation.format_violation: The generated answer did not meet the required format and was discarded.
validation.unsupported: The generated answer could not be verified against the retrieved sources.

action.widen: Change the jurisdiction scope if the applicable law is at another level.
action.rephrase: Rephrase the question using the terms of the article or legal concept.
action.upload: Upload the missing document or statute so it becomes a source.

viewer.title: Source
viewer.reformed: This provision changed after it was cited ({change}, {date}). Current version:

footer.disclaimer: Research tool. It does not replace a lawyer's professional judgment.

workbench.slowNote: With the local model an answer takes 1.5 to 4 minutes; a topic without sources is refused in seconds.
workbench.scopeFixed: Scope fixed at creation; start a new one to change it.

history.failed: The history could not be loaded.

bar.shared: A colleague's conversation, shared through the matter: you can read and continue it.

sources.title: Cited sources
sources.empty: Cited sources will appear here. Select one to read the original text.

chat.title: Chat
chat.welcomeTitle: What do you need to look up?
chat.welcomeBody: Write your question; if the law is from a state or municipality, use “Change”. Every assertion cites its source and follow-up questions keep the sources already cited.
chat.ex1: What are the grounds for terminating an employment relationship without liability for the employer?
chat.ex2: How many hours can a daytime work shift last?
chat.ex3: What rights does a worker have during pregnancy?

research.title: Research
research.welcomeBody: State the research question. The result is a dossier with the issue, the applicable law, case law, analysis and cited sources, exportable to PDF.
research.placeholder: Describe the legal problem to research…
research.question: Question
research.ex1: What severance is owed to a worker for unjustified dismissal?
research.ex2: What requirements must the employer's termination notice meet?

case.newBody: Describe the facts and the side you represent. In each round, write an argument and ask for the opposing counsel's attack or for the argument to be strengthened with the sources.
case.title: Case name
case.claim: Claim or theory of the case
case.privacyNote: The facts are stored for your user only, inside the firm, and never leave this machine.
case.privacyNoteRemote: The facts are stored for your user only, inside the firm. With an external model, the facts and every argument are sent to that provider to generate the answer.
case.composerPlaceholder: Write the argument you want to test…

example.title: Dismissal without written notice
example.facts: The employee worked three years as an administrative assistant. On March 3 she was dismissed verbally; the employer gave her no written termination notice. The employer now alleges dishonesty that it never documented.

workbench.refusalReady: There are not enough sources to answer; suggestions are shown.
workbench.busyElsewhere: An answer is in progress in another conversation. You can send when it finishes.
workbench.examplesLabel: Not sure where to start? Try an example:

scope.personaHelp: The profile guides vocabulary and the order of sources; it neither widens nor narrows the jurisdiction.
scope.historicalHelp: Turn it on only if you need what a law said before an amendment.

model.label: Model
model.help: Fixed when the conversation starts and recorded in the audit log. Every model goes through the same citation checks.

summary.gemma: The most accurate local model; slower.
summary.qwen: Faster; in the evaluation it refused many questions that did have a source.

model.measured: Measured ({date}, {cases} cases): answered {answered} of the questions with a source · refused {refusal} of those without one · valid citations {precision} · {seconds} s typical
model.notReviewed: cases not yet reviewed by a lawyer
model.unmeasured: Not measured: the evaluation has not been run with this model yet.
model.remoteWarning: With this model, your question, the conversation history and the retrieved law fragments are sent to Anthropic to generate every answer. Do not use it unless the firm has authorized it for the matter.

home.title: What do you need to solve today?
home.intro: It answers only from the loaded laws and cites every source. When it finds no basis, it says so instead of making it up.

modeHelp.ask: A short answer with its sources; you can keep asking.
modeHelp.research: An organized dossier (issue, laws, analysis and sources), exportable to PDF.
modeHelp.case: Describe the facts; then test your arguments against opposing counsel.

placeholder.ask: e.g. What are the grounds for termination without liability for the employer?
placeholder.research: e.g. What severance applies to an unjustified dismissal?

home.recentTitle: Pick up where you left off
home.recentEmpty: Your recent work will appear here.

matters.title: Matters
matters.intro: Each matter gathers the work on one client file. Only you and the colleagues you add can see it.
matters.loadError: The matters could not be loaded. Please try again.
matters.empty: You have no matters yet. Create the first one with the form above.
matters.privacy: The matter is private: only you and the people you add can see it.
matters.notFound: The matter does not exist or you have no access to it.
matters.confirmDelete: Delete the matter? Its conversations are not deleted: they become private to their authors again. The documents uploaded to the matter ARE deleted.
matters.noWork: There are no conversations in this matter yet.
matters.reformedOpen: This source was amended after it was saved.
matters.sourcesHelp: To save a source, open it (from an answer or from Laws) and use “Save to matter”.
matters.addMember: Add a colleague from the firm
matters.noColleagues: There are no more colleagues from the firm to add.
matters.membersHelp: People you add see the whole matter and can work on it; only the owner manages it.

picker.label: Matter
picker.help: Optional: keep it inside a matter to share it with your colleagues.

laws.title: Laws
laws.intro: Read the current text of each loaded law, exactly as published, and compare it with earlier versions. No model is involved here.
laws.loadError: The laws could not be loaded. Please try again.
laws.notFound: That law has no such article.
laws.pick: Choose an article in the structure or type its number.
laws.citablesHelp: Each part has its own citation. You can copy it or save it to a matter.
laws.onlyVersion: Only one version of this article is recorded.
laws.diffLegend: Underlined text: added by the amendment. Struck-through text: removed.
laws.didNotExist: The article did not exist in that version.
laws.noLongerExists: The article no longer exists in the current version.

reforms.title: Amendments
reforms.intro: The system checks the official sources and, when a law changes, loads the new version without deleting the old one and tells you which part of your work cites amended provisions.
reforms.loadError: The amendments could not be loaded. Please try again.
reforms.noAlerts: None of your conversations, saved sources or verifications cites an amended provision.
reforms.noChanges: No amendment has been recorded yet.
reforms.checksHelp: If an official source refuses automated downloads, it is noted and not retried.
reforms.noChecks: No source has been checked yet.
reforms.bannerBody: {n} citations in your work point to provisions that changed.

verify.title: Verify citations
verify.intro: Check every article a brief cites: whether it exists, whether it is current and whether the quoted text matches the law. The check is done by the system, not by the model.
verify.mode: How do you want to provide the brief?
verify.docTitlePlaceholder: For example: Answer to the complaint
verify.textPlaceholder: Paste the whole brief here, or the part you want to check.
verify.example: Want to see how it works?
verify.exampleText: Con fundamento en el artículo 47, fracción II, de la Ley Federal del Trabajo, que establece como causa de rescisión "Incurrir el trabajador, durante sus labores, en faltas de probidad u honradez", así como en el artículo 48 de la misma ley. Véase también el artículo 21 de la Ley del Seguro Social.
verify.fileHelp: The PDF must contain text (not a scanned image). Reading it may take a minute or two.
verify.privacy: The brief is not stored: it is processed on this computer and only the report is kept (references and results, without the text).
verify.runningPdf: Reading the PDF and checking the references…

errors.tooLarge: The file is too large (15 MB maximum).
errors.unreadable: No text could be read from the file. Is it a scanned PDF?
errors.generic: The brief could not be verified. Please try again.

verify.none: No article references were found in the text.
verify.pdfWarnings: Note: part of the PDF could not be read well; review the result carefully.
verify.disclaimer: The check covers existence, validity and verbatim match. It does not judge whether the brief's interpretation is right.

statusHelp.vigente: The provision exists in the current version of the law.
statusHelp.derogado: The provision exists but is repealed in the current version.
statusHelp.no_vigente: The provision only exists in an earlier version: an amendment removed or replaced it.
statusHelp.inexistente: The law is loaded but has no such provision. Check the article or fraction number.
statusHelp.fuera_del_corpus: The cited law is not loaded in the system; it cannot be verified.
statusHelp.ley_no_identificada: It was not possible to tell which law the reference belongs to. Check that the brief names the law.
statusHelp.ambigua: The law's name matches more than one loaded law (for example, “Código Civil”).

quote.coincide_version_anterior: The quotation matches an earlier version

verify.inferred: The law is not named next to the reference: it was taken from the last law mentioned. Please confirm.

settings.title: Settings
settings.allowRemote: Allow the firm to use Claude (Anthropic)
settings.allowRemoteHelp: When on, whoever starts a conversation with Claude sends their questions, the history and the retrieved fragments to Anthropic. Gemma and Qwen stay on this machine. When turned off, conversations with Claude can no longer continue.
settings.remoteNotConfigured: This server has no Anthropic key configured: Claude is unavailable even if allowed.
settings.adminOnly: Only a firm administrator can change this.

files.title: Firm documents
files.intro: Upload contracts, briefs, rulings or a law that is not loaded. The assistant can cite them in your conversations, the same way it cites the law.
files.fileHelp: PDF with text, Word (.docx) or plain text. 25 MB at most. A scanned PDF (images only) cannot be read.
files.docTitleHelp: This is how it will appear in citations. Left empty, the file name is used.

kinds.norma: Law, regulation or rule not loaded

files.whereHelpAll: It will appear in conversations of any scope in this country.
files.whereHelpNarrow: It will appear only in conversations of this scope. A federal conversation or one of another state will not see it.
files.visibleFirm: No matter: the whole firm can consult it.
files.visibleMatter: Inside the matter: only its members will see it, and it will be used only in the conversations of that matter.
files.privacy: The original file is not stored. It is read on this computer, only its text is kept, and nobody outside your firm can see it.
files.uploadedAnnounce: “{title}” was received and is being processed.
files.empty: There are no documents yet. Upload the first one with the form above.

status.ready: Ready · {count, plural, =1 {# citable part} other {# citable parts}}

files.processingHelp: You can keep working; this list updates itself. A long PDF takes a few minutes.

failed.no_text: No text was found. If it is a scanned PDF, convert it to a PDF with text (OCR) first, or upload the Word file.
failed.unreadable: The file is damaged or password-protected and could not be opened.
failed.too_long: The document is too long. Split it and upload the parts separately.
failed.embedder_unavailable: The local search engine did not respond. Check that the application is running and upload it again.
failed.generation_mismatch: The search index changed version and this document cannot be mixed with it. Tell whoever administers the system.
failed.interrupted: Processing was interrupted (the application was closed). Delete it and upload it again.
failed.internal: An error occurred while processing it. Delete it and try again.

files.textHelp: This is the text as the system read it, part by part. Check it before relying on it: if something is missing here, the assistant will not see it either.
files.noUnits: There is no text to show.
files.confirmDelete: Delete the document? Its text is erased; conversations that cited it keep the name of the citation but can no longer open it.

errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.unsupported: That kind of file cannot be read. Use PDF, Word (.docx) or plain text.
errors.busy: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.matter: The matter is no longer available. Choose another or upload it without a matter.
errors.generic: The document could not be uploaded. Try again.
